# gutenberg-block-library

> Accessible server-rendered Gutenberg blocks with a WordPress block-grammar parser and serializer, attribute validation and markup that passes axe-core with zero violations Composer package `trysac/u951-gutenberg-block-library`, namespace `Trysac\GutenbergBlockLibrary`, MIT
> licensed, PHP >= 8.4, standard library only.
